item: K13 reads the verticals already persisted (row 183, R751)
summary: K13 had no resolver. It now lists one block per vertical: climate from a record the fetch job writes after its session commits (per dataset: last fetch, figures, new, revised; never the station or region), elections from the shipped catalogue and the Wikidata snapshot on disk (the snapshot is the first slice). Nothing is fetched or scanned on the GET. Never measured, fetched-nothing-new and source-gave-no-figures stay apart. R751(d): the target names the open bar, so the verdict is measured-no-bar with a count of verticals whose first slice is in (n = verticals listed). Lane blocks join in row 184.
